name: Build a product
goalText: Launch a tiny habit-tracking web app prototype for five beta users in six weeks.

interviewOutputArtifact.goalSummary: Ship a small habit-tracking web app prototype to five beta users.
interviewOutputArtifact.coreWhy: The user wants proof that they can finish and share a useful product instead of endlessly planning ideas.
interviewOutputArtifact.successDefinition: Five beta users can create a habit, mark a check-in, and send feedback after one week.
interviewOutputArtifact.currentStage: The user has sketches and technical ability but keeps expanding scope before shipping.
interviewOutputArtifact.compactSourceSummary: The user needs a narrow prototype path with user research, feedback, and a real beta launch.

transcript.content: I want to build a habit tracker, but every idea becomes too big.
What is the smallest launch that would still count?
Five beta users can track one habit for a week and tell me what confused them.
